Definition: Heman, the name of at least two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Heman = "faithful"; 1) a wise man to whom Solomon was compared; 2) son of Joel, grandson of Samuel, and a Levitical singer and author of PS 88; 3) a seer
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
